method.observations: Four demonstrated gripper-opening windows; one original validation, three added training
method.selection: Largest mean gripper opening at offsets 20:32 versus offsets 0:8; frame >=32 and <=length-34
method.physical_metric: Mean absolute difference over 32 steps and 12 arm coordinates in host range_m100_100 units
method.physical_scope: Offline action chunks, without clipping or robot execution; grippers excluded from arm12

replay.input: Current observation only; generated future video

one_step.input: Noised demonstrated future video and action, observed video prefix clamped
one_step.metric: Relative L2 change of velocity in the first 14 normalized action coordinates

method.color: Exchange blue/green hue in saturated forward-view pixels below image mid-height; wrists and baskets retained
method.masking: Remove selected attention keys/values, preserving other valid context; no weight updates
method.layer_groups: Zero-indexed groups of five paired Transformer layers; video-to-action attention masked
method.layer_response: Mean per-window relative L2 across all residual tokens after each paired layer
method.scope: Local pathway interventions and training-example fit; task outcome measured separately
